23. Verification vs validation

Verification checks whether specified requirements are met; validation checks whether the product
satisfies intended use.

Requirement: search by name
Check: query 'soap' returns soap
User feedback: category filter needed
Expected result: Specification passes; user validation reveals an unmet need.

Q: Can verified software fail validation?
A: Yes, if requirements do not reflect actual user needs.
